motions.info_slide_plain: "Delphi Systems" are a type of systems where digital information of all people in a country (such as phone calls, messages, GPS location, etc) is continuously saved in a database. This database is accessible only through general anonymous searches, without access to an individual's data unless they fall under specific criteria.
motions.text: THW allow law enforcement agencies (NSA, FBI, Shin Bet, Police, etc) to implement Delphi Systems.

motions.info_slide_plain: Respectability politics refers to attempts by marginalized groups to police their own members and show their social values as being continuous and compatible with mainstream values
motions.text: This House believes that prominent institutions in marginalized communities (places of worship, schools, community centers, etc.) should espouse Respectability Politics rather than challenging the mainstream for their failure to accept differences in values.

motions.info_slide_plain:
The Euroasian Economic Union (EAEU) is an economic union between Russia, Kazakhstan, Armenia, Belarus and Kyrgyzstan. 
The EAEU allows for the free movement of people, goods and services, as well as facilitating common policies in the macroeconomic sphere such as customs.
